evidence.note: During the build, plan lines enumerated the remaining endpoint groups to add (OAuth, accounts, statuses, timelines, search, notifications, media, polls, lists, admin, reports, SSE, UI), showing an accurate what's-left picture across a large surface.

Verification phase systematically ticked through subsystems one by one (instance, introspect, admin queues/audit/lists, trends, durability, scopes, search, webfinger, media, polls, reports, PKCE) — broad, non-repetitive coverage indicating a maintained done-vs-remaining view.

Explicitly reconciled against concrete requirement sets: JS hash pins + anti-cheat file scan, the seed-pool minimums (≥8 accounts/≥20 statuses/CW/media), and numbered lists of remaining edge-case checks.
Bugs (TemplateResponse signature, template var mismatch, 404 handler, login 405, cold-start slowness) each diagnosed and fixed without looping or getting stuck — no circular debugging observed.

reasoning: The agent kept a usable, continuously-updated running picture of subsystems and constraints and reconciled it against concrete targets (seed minimums, hash pins, endpoint lists), clearly exceeding the level-5 'usable running checklist' anchor and never dropping a named subsystem or thrashing on a bug. However it relied on ephemeral per-step prose rather than an explicit granular verified-vs-pending ledger, and never demonstrated deliberate time-boxing of a stuck state (none arose), so it falls short of the level-8 anchor. This lands at 6.
